snippet.title: Death By Scrolling Launches April 16 | Console Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Death By Scrolling launches April 16 on Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch.

Fight your way up through the chaotic world of Purgatory Inc. in this vertically scrolling action roguelite. The screen never stops rising, enemies keep coming, and the Grim Reaper is always close behind.

Choose from unique characters, build powerful runs, and survive long enough to earn your escape. Along the way, encounter strange enemies, vendors, and side quests as you climb higher with every attempt.

The April release also brings a major update across all platforms, including a new playable character, a brand-new biome, and multiple gameplay improvements.

The only way out is up.

Wishlist now:

Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mx2xgqzmhpk
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016066
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/death-by-scrolling-switch/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3773590/Death_by_Scrolling/
